component.name: OldAmber
component.summary: The Poke RBY Generation 1 engine, rebuilt, using a ROM you supply

description.p: A rebuild of the original Game Boy game in C and SDL2. It contains no game data of its own: no graphics, no music, no statistics. All of that is read out of a ROM you supply from your own computer the first time it runs, and the ROM is only read, never modified or copied.
The launcher asks for the ROM, builds the game data, and starts the game. That happens once. It can be driven entirely with a game controller.
Adds configurable rendering rates, improves widescreen presentation, and moves Windows saves to stable per-user storage.
